mintAuthority.summary: msUSD is minted in Metronome Synth by depositing crypto collateral (75-85% CF); upgrade authority over the token proxy is controlled by a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe (no modules, no timelock).

controls.label: msUSD token proxy (EIP-1967, OZ TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.capDescription: msUSD is minted only against deposited collateral within Metronome Synth pools at governance-set collateral factors (75-85%); supply is bounded by collateralized debt with no off-protocol issuer minter and no direct redemption.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,290,617, EIP-1967 slots confirmed: implementation = 0xd8a7ceccecbeded9f5350f4ca8faf55ab92f3390, proxy admin = 0x2fa85a496a9b79c6d50cef590304bdd36efa2dcc (OZ ProxyAdmin).

controls.label: Metronome DAO multisig (3-of-5 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: ProxyAdmin owner = 0xd1DE3F9CD4AE2F23DA941a67cA4C739f8dD9Af33. Safe API confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0, 3-of-5, nonce 365, no modules, no guard at block 25,290,617.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,290,617: msUSD proxy admin = 0x2fa85a496a9b79c6d50cef590304bdd36efa2dcc (OZ ProxyAdmin) → owner = 0xd1DE3F9CD4AE2F23DA941a67cA4C739f8dD9Af33 (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0, 3-of-5, no modules). No timelock. Full governance chain verified on-chain. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the undelayed Metronome Safe can change mint logic or collateral parameters, and the disclosed unbacked synth-swap float prevents whole-supply reconciliation; no prudential supervisor or independent attestor is identified.
